title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・沈黙を晴らす光

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright shines as bright as the sun, shedding light on the glory of the Mejiro family as she completes the autumn Tenno Sho against Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After praising the fighting spirit of the other, the two racers go their separate ways.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Mejiro Bright's fight is not over yet. She swears to bring more glory to the Mejiro family at the year-end race, the Arima Kinen.
